open_items: A1, A2, B1 and C1 handbooks and "Tipps" documents were not linked from the profile pages that were read; only the Übungstest was used for those levels.
The blueprint link to the B2 "Tipps" PDF returned 404; the working URL (capital P in "Pruefungsvorbereitung") comes from the official B2 page.
Every extraction below was done from the PDF text by software and still needs a human check against the PDF pages.
